question: Will Anthropic release a system card of a model at a new frontier of intellegence by August 31st?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves yes if Anthropic releases a new system card for a new model described as Mythos class or as their new most powerful model, or anything that could generally be understood as such, by August 31st, 11:59 et. It resolves no otherwise. 

Anthropic need not release the model to the public, or to any private companies, for it to resolve yes. 

I may trade on this market

Update 2026-07-24 (PST) (AI summary of creator comment): - Opus 5 will not count for a YES resolution.

# Research report 1 of 2

# Research brief: Will Anthropic publish a system card for a new frontier model (Mythos-class or its most powerful) by Aug 31, 2026?

I only used information dated on or before 2026-08-15. Many results were dated later, and I left them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question doesn't link a source. The relevant place to watch is Anthropic's system cards page and its Transparency Hub. [system cards](https://www.anthropic.com/system-cards) | [transparency hub](https://www.anthropic.com/transparency)
- 2026-07-24: The most recent system card I could confirm is Claude Opus 5's. The question creator has said Opus 5 does not count. [Opus 5 card](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/ceaf5c7ff2783855203fde8208ec311252dced5b/Claude%20Opus%205%20System%20Card.pdf)
- 2026-06-30: Claude Sonnet 5 system card. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-system-card)
- I couldn't get a clean snapshot of the system cards page as of Aug 15. One search summary said it listed only models up to Mythos Preview (April 2026), so the page may lag behind the PDFs.

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-15 I found no new system card for a model above Mythos 5 or Fable 5, and no "Mythos-class" card. The question is not settled.
- 2026-08-14: Anthropic's August 2026 Risk Report (RSP 3.4, covering Feb 24 to Jul 15) disclosed an unreleased internal model called "Model 2." It scored 62.8% on the internal CoBench evaluation, against 50.3% for Mythos 5. That means a stronger model exists internally, but a risk report is not a system card. [newsbytes](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/anthropics-august-2026-risk-report-rates-full-automation-risk-low/tldr) | [vorplabs](https://vorplabs.com/ai-regulatory-updates/reports/2026-08-anthropic-risk-report) | [zeli](https://zeli.app/en/story/49303540)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-14: The Risk Report raised Anthropic's catastrophic-misalignment rating from "very low" to "low," citing incidents during cybersecurity evaluations. It also says automated-R&D risk could become a major concern within 6 to 12 months. [AI Automation Global](https://aiautomationglobal.com/blog/anthropic-risk-report-misalignment-enterprise-ai-agents-2026)
- 2026-07-24: Opus 5 launched. Zvi's review says it matches or beats Fable 5 and Mythos 5 on many evaluations but trails Mythos 5 on chaining cyber exploits ("Highly Capable, But Is No Mythos"). [Zvi](https://thezvi.substack.com/p/claude-opus-5-is-highly-capable-but)
- 2026-07-01: Anthropic redeployed Fable 5 and Mythos 5 after export controls were lifted. (From a search summary; I didn't check the primary source.)
- 2026-06-21: Andrew Curran, a third-party analyst, reported that a more capable Mythos model had finished training. The name (5.1 or 6) and whether it would stay internal were both unknown. Anthropic has not confirmed this. [runtimewire](https://runtimewire.com/article/andrew-curran-says-a-stronger-anthropic-mythos-model-has-emerged-from-training) | [huxiu](https://m.huxiu.com/article/4869198.html)
- ~2026-06-12: The US government forced Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for a time. [pasqualepillitteri](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/5760/mythos-6-successor-trained-anthropic)
- 2026-06-09: Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class, public) launched, along with a restricted Mythos 5. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/09/anthropic-mythos-claude-fable-5.html)
- 2026-04-07: Claude Mythos Preview was announced, with access limited to Project Glasswing partners. It came with a system card. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_Mythos) | [Medium](https://medium.com/@AIchats/anthropic-releases-claude-mythos-system-card-501703e9f77d)

## 4. Base rates
- In 2026 Anthropic has published a frontier-tier ("Mythos-class") system card about every 2 months: Mythos Preview (Apr 7), then Fable 5 / Mythos 5 (Jun 9). By Aug 15 it had been about 9.5 weeks since the last one.
- Counting all model cards, the pace is roughly one a month: Sonnet 5 (Jun 30), Opus 5 (Jul 24). Most of those don't qualify here.
- Per Curran, the original Mythos finished training Feb 7 and was announced Apr 7, a lag of about 2 months. If the successor finished training around mid-June, the same lag points to mid-to-late August. That's a rough analogy, not evidence.
- One complication: Model 2 was disclosed in a risk report rather than with a card. It's unclear whether an internal-only model would ever get a standalone system card.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has a market called "Next Mythos-class model released by...". It needs a release to the general public, which is stricter than this question, since this question doesn't require any release. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/next-mythos-class-model-released-by) | [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/tech/next-mythos-class-model-released-by)
  - ~2026-06-11: Aug 31 contract around 45%. [casino.org](https://www.casino.org/news/anthropic-prediction-markets/)
  - 2026-07-31: Aug 31 at 43%, Sep 30 at 71%. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/?p=550780)
  - A separate undated snapshot had Aug 31 at about 42% and Sep 30 at 81%. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/2487205)
- Kalshi lists an "Opus 6 before Sep 1" market at about 11 to 13%, as shown by an aggregator. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/answer/claude-opus6). There is also a Kalshi Mythos ticker (KXCLAUDE-MYTH), but I couldn't open it.
- I found no Manifold market on this exact question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (Aug 15 to 31)
- A possible announcement of the Mythos successor that Curran reported (Mythos 5.1 or 6), or of Model 2. Either would very likely come with a system card.
- Outlets and leakers were tracking possible codenames, for example a "claude-oceanus-v1-p" reportedly given to red-teamers. The date of that report is unclear. [WinCentral](https://thewincentral.com/claude-mythos-oceanus-leak-launch-soon/)
- Regulation could cause delays: there were earlier US government restrictions on Mythos-class deployment, and the Risk Report flagged evaluation incidents.
- Ambiguity in how this question resolves: it's unclear whether a refresh card (for example an x.1 model only slightly above Mythos 5) or a card for an internal-only model would count as "a new frontier."

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I couldn't find any event on or before August 15 that settles this question. The last new Mythos-class system card was for Mythos 5 / Fable 5 on June 9. Opus 5's card came out July 24, but Opus 5 has been ruled out. A more capable Mythos successor was reported as finished training in June, but Anthropic hasn't confirmed it or given a date.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no URL. In practice it is decided by Anthropic's system card publications on its Transparency Hub and CDN. [transparency hub](https://www.anthropic.com/transparency)
- 2026-07-24: the newest system card I could confirm by August 15 is the one for Claude Opus 5. The question creator said on 2026-07-24 that Opus 5 does not count. [Opus 5 card](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/ceaf5c7ff2783855203fde8208ec311252dced5b/Claude%20Opus%205%20System%20Card.pdf)
- I couldn't load the hub's current listing directly (the fetches were blocked).

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-15 I found no system card for a model newer and more capable than Mythos 5 / Fable 5. The question is not settled.
- 2026-06-09: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 to the public and Claude Mythos 5 to vetted partners. That was the last new frontier-class release. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/06/09/anthropic-mythos-class-safeguards), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/06/09/anthropic-releases-its-first-mythos-model-to-the-public/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-24: Anthropic launched Opus 5. It was described as close to Fable 5 on many tasks at half the price, and Fable 5 stayed the recommended model for the hardest long-running autonomous work. So Opus 5 is not a new frontier. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/anthropic-launches-opus-5/), [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/07/24/anthropic-releases-new-model-opus-5), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/anthropics-opus-5-nears-mythos-5-on-finding-bugs-but-falls-short-on-exploits/)
- 2026-07: Yahoo/Opus 5 coverage says Anthropic is preparing for an IPO later this year. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/anthropic-debuts-opus-5-model-as-company-preps-for-ipo-later-this-year-170000070.html)
- 2026-07-01: access for foreign nationals was restored after a US Commerce Department suspension that began about 3 days after the June 9 launch. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_Mythos)
- 2026-06-21: analyst Andrew Curran reported that a more capable successor to Mythos 5 (possibly "Mythos 5.1" or "Mythos 6") had finished training. Anthropic has not confirmed this. [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/5760/mythos-6-successor-trained-anthropic), [thewincentral](https://thewincentral.com/anthropic-stronger-than-mythos-5-ai-model-leak/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-04-07: Claude Mythos Preview system card, described as Anthropic's "most capable frontier model to date". [card](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/08ab9158070959f88f296514c21b7facce6f52bc.pdf)
- 2026-06-09: Mythos 5 / Fable 5 launched, about 9 weeks later.
- That makes two frontier-level cards in about 4 months, roughly one every 2 months. By August 31 it will have been about 12 weeks since June 9, which is longer than the previous gap.
- Anthropic also releases models of other tiers between frontier cards (Opus 4.8, Opus 5). The window left is only 16 days.
- If the June 21 report is right, the successor finished training about 8 weeks before August 15. Anthropic's safety testing and system-card work often take weeks to months, and Mythos-class models have also faced government review.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has a "Next Mythos-Class Model release date" market with August 31 and September contracts. I couldn't load its price as of August 15. [CryptoSlate mirror](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/next-mythos-class-model-released-date/), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/anthropic-expected-to-release-new-mythos-model-by-thursday-per-polymarket/)
- Kalshi has a "Mythos model 2026" market, but I couldn't confirm its prices as of August 15. [predictmarketcap](https://predictmarketcap.com/events/will-anthropic-release-mythos-before-jan-1-2027)
- Polymarket also has a separate market on which company has the best AI model at the end of August. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/de/events/which-company-has-best-ai-model-end-of-august-20260717015626546)
- The news coverage of these market prices that I found was dated after August 15, so I left it out. Check the live Polymarket order book yourself.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Anthropic could announce a Mythos 5 successor at any time. I found no confirmed event or date.
- Things that could cause a delay: US government review of Mythos-class models (which already led to the June suspension) and work on safety classifiers.
- IPO preparation might push Anthropic to show off a frontier model, but I found no evidence tying it to August.
- A model with a new name that is not clearly above Mythos 5, like Opus 5, would probably not count under the creator's clarification.
